title: A Comprehensive Framework for All Stages of Large-Model Training: From Data and Tokenization, through Pretraining, to Post-Training Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33451v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) arise from the synergy of the full training pipeline, including data and tokenization, pretraining, and post-training (supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, reinforcement learning, and continual optimization), rather than any individual stage. Existing surveys mostly adopt a single-stage or single-technique perspective, treating related research as isolated systems without unified stage division or a horizontally comparable basis.   This paper proposes a unified stage division and a six-dimensional analytical framework covering data, objective function, optimization strategy, system constraints, evaluation, and risk and governance. We systematically review 395 core references from 2017 to 2026, and present a conceptual map of cross-stage effects: forward constraints of pretraining on post-training, and reverse empowerment of post-training on data and pre

translated_title: 大模型训练全阶段综合框架：从数据与分词，经预训练，到后训练对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的能力源于完整训练流程的协同作用，包括数据与分词、预训练以及后训练（监督微调、偏好对齐、强化学习和持续优化），而非任何单一阶段。现有综述大多采用单阶段或单技术的视角，将相关研究视为孤立系统，缺乏统一的阶段划分和横向可比的基础。本文提出了统一的阶段划分，以及一个涵盖数据、目标函数、优化策略、系统约束、评估、风险与治理六个维度的分析框架。我们系统性地回顾了2017年至2026年的395篇核心参考文献，并呈现了跨阶段影响的概念图：预训练对后训练的前向约束，以及后训练对数据和预训练的逆向赋能。
tldr: 本文提出了覆盖大模型训练全流程的统一阶段划分与六维分析框架，系统梳理了395篇核心文献，并揭示了预训练与后训练之间双向的跨阶段影响机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified stage division and six-dimensional analytical framework covering the entire large-model training pipeline, systematically reviewing 395 core references and revealing bidirectional cross-stage effects between pretraining and post-training.
